subject: GCP Marketplace private offer: commit utilization plan & co-sell alignment
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@gcp-partners.google.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: gcp-account-ops@google.com
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft private offer + commit cadence for BetaApps (next steps)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment on BetaApps as a co-sell candidate. I attached a starter private offer workbook that GCP uses to translate a commitment into marketplace SKUs and billing cadence. A few open questions we need from Redwood to finalize the private offer: 

- Preferred commit drawdown cadence: monthly or quarterly? (GCP ops needs this to set the billing window)
- Forecast granularity: do you want us to use monthly forecast submitted by the 25th of the prior month, or a one-time annual schedule?
- Any constraints on SKU mapping (e.g., reserved capacity + on-demand burst SKUs)?

Also, how would you like to handle co-sell credit timing — immediate payout vs post-usage reconciliation? That affects the statement-of-work and our internal finance routing.

I've CC'd account ops so they can weigh in on billing windows and any marketplace product/sku limits. Attached: redwood_private_offer_workbook.xlsx (starter).

If we can get answers by EOD Monday (5/4) I can circulate a private offer draft to BetaApps and start DocuSign routing the same week.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Partner Sales, GCP Marketplace
Google Cloud Partner Sales

Attachment: redwood_private_offer_workbook.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@gcp-partners.google.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft private offer + commit cadence for BetaApps (next steps)

Ana — thanks, and appreciate the clear checklist. Quick answers from our side: 

- Preferred cadence: monthly drawdown aligned to actual monthly consumption where possible. That keeps our cost model predictable for BetaApps while avoiding a large quarterly billing hangover.
- Forecasting: monthly forecast submitted by the 25th prior month sounds workable. We'll need a small buffer for burst usage (on-demand SKU).
- SKU mapping: prefer a two-tier SKU: Reserved Pool (committed baseline) + Burst (metered on-demand). We'll provide recommended capacities per region.

Rafael will attach a completed workbook with our recommended values and a pricing summary. Sergio — can you confirm if a minimum monthly commit of ~$40k USD is acceptable from the marketplace side for BetaApps? If that floor won't work we should propose an adjusted cadence.

Regarding co-sell credits, we prefer credits applied on a monthly reconciliation (i.e., credits show against the following month invoice after usage reconciliation). Is that compatible with Google ops?

Happy to hop on a 30m tomorrow if useful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@gcp-partners.google.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft private offer + commit cadence for BetaApps (workbook + summary)

Folks — attaching our completed workbook (redwood_gcp_private_offer_workbook_v2.xlsx) and the proposed private offer terms (Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms_20260501.pdf). High level summary below: 

- Baseline monthly commit: $45,000 USD (Reserved Pool SKU)
- Burst/On-demand: metered SKU billed at usage rate; estimated monthly burst forecast of 10-15% during peak launches
- Billing cadence: monthly drawdown on the 1st of each month based on prior-month reconciliation (forecast submitted by 25th)
- Co-sell credits: applied monthly as a credit on the subsequent invoice after reconciliation (GCP ops: please confirm timing)
- SKU mapping: one regional reserved SKU per GCP region used + a global metered SKU for overflow

Open items for GCP/Procurement: 
- Confirmation that $45k/month meets marketplace minimums and is eligible for co-sell credits.
- DocuSign routing party list (BetaApps procurement contact + Redwood signer).
- Any marketplace constraints on rolling over unused commit between months.

Next steps I propose: 1) Ana/GCP ops confirm billing window + credit timing, 2) BetaApps procurement accepts private offer draft or proposes redlines, 3) We route on DocuSign. I've penciled a 30m slot Mon 5/4 10:00am PT for a quick alignment — confirm if you can make it.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_gcp_private_offer_workbook_v2.xlsx; Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms_20260501.pdf
From: procurement@betaapps.com <procurement@betaapps.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@gcp-partners.google.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: gcp-account-ops@google.com
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft private offer + commit cadence for BetaApps (procurement redlines)

Hi all,

Thanks for the workbook and the clear summary. BetaApps is generally comfortable with the $45k/month baseline but procurement has two small asks before we can sign: 

1) Billing window: we'd prefer the invoice to reflect actual usage with a 10 business day reconciliation window after month-end (i.e., final usage posted by the 10th, invoice issued the 12th). That gives our finance team time to reconcile credits and avoids surprises.
2) Unused commit roll-forward: request a one-month roll-forward for up to 20% of unused commit (to accommodate spikes). Anything beyond that should be forfeited.

If GCP ops is okay with the reconciliation window and the roll-forward rule, we can accept the private offer terms. Please send DocuSign route to procurement@betaapps.com and our CFO (cfo@betaapps.com).

Cc'd GCP ops for confirmation on the invoice timing and co-sell credit mechanics.

Best regards,
Elena Park
Head of Procurement
BetaApps, Inc.
